fishing: WHEN: Saturday morning Oct 3. Solunar major 6:19–8:19a lines up with sunrise (7:23a) and a morning high around 6:24a on Lemon Bay; afternoon low ~2:38–3:54p. Coefficient 41, light current. SE 10–15 kt easing, storms building after 2p — fish the pass early. Snook season still open (slot 28–33, 1/day) through Nov 30. PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 10/2 has redfish and snook on the shoreline edges of the trough; Stump Pass islands still the hold from earlier in the month, Spanish were just outside the pass. Manasota beach first light is the snook window before the chop builds. LEMON BAY: 10/2 docks and mangroves holding mangrove snapper, small black drum, redfish and snook; trout on the grass. NEARSHORE: fall mix — mangrove snapper inside 20 miles, permit and cobia on wrecks, Spanish around bait (Waterline / Economy Tackle mid-Sep; Franks 10/2 west wall reds strong after the weak front). Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, pinfish, white bait, gold spoons, topwater.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (three Sarasota samples); not observed in Charlotte, including Englewood Beach 6.4 mi W and Stump Pass. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 9/28 (Healthy Beaches, updated 10/3). Englewood Beach last listed 20 CFU on 9/21, no advisory.
fpl: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 148 customers out this morning; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
